Main Upgrading Programme:
Interior upgrading programmes for flats built up to 1986, and
HIP which have not undergone MUP, with added optional improvements
Home Improvement Programme:
Interior upgrading programmes for flats built up to 1986, and
HIP which have not undergone MUP, with added optional improvements
Interim Upgrading Programme: The common areas of a precinct were upgraded, landscape upgrading programmes stopped in flavour of IUP Plus
Selective En bloc Redevelopment Scheme: Announced in August 1995, it is a scheme that rejuvenates the older low-rise blocks (prior to 1996) into the high-rise blocks.
Lift Upgrading Programme:
Direct level access to lift for flats built up to 1990,
IUP Plus – a combination of two programmes, IUP and LUP
Interim Upgrading Programme Plus:
Direct level access to lift for flats built up to 1990,
IUP Plus – a combination of two programmes, IUP and LUP
Neighbourhood Renewal Programme: This would include MUP/HIP (interior) and IUP Plus (landscape) as it focus on block and neighbourhood improvements
Selective Lift Replacement Programme: Replace about 750 old lifts with modern lifts that come with more energy-efficient motors, vision panels and infra-red doors with motion safety sensors for added energy efficiency, safety and security
